remarks: WELCOME TO 35 GLENROCK. This 1-bedroom beauty has more to offer than some 2-bedrooms: brand-new floors throughout, fresh carpet in the bedroom, central air, a private balcony, a kitchen facelift featuring new quartz countertops, new sink, and appliances (ready for all your fall recipes), plus a bathroom with jacuzzi jets, a roomy vanity, and your own in-unit washer & dryer. Freshly painted, too! And it doesn't stop there... you also get a spacious private storage room, a garage, plus a second parking spot. Summer 2026 will be here before you know it-start planning those pool days with your faves! Just a 6-min stroll to Merritt 7 train station, in a pet-friendly complex built in 1991. HOA is just $244/month. DON'T MISS THE VIDEO WALKTHROUGH! Rules and Regulations attached.
